## Summary

<!-- What changed and why? -->

## Validation

- [ ] `npm audit --audit-level=moderate`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` when UI behavior changed
- [ ] iOS tests when native code changed

## Data, privacy, and accessibility

- [ ] New data sources have documented redistribution terms and attribution
- [ ] No credentials, device identifiers, or precise user-location data were committed
- [ ] User-facing changes remain keyboard and screen-reader accessible
- [ ] User-facing text is localized where appropriate
